system.description: When you select this Talent, choose one Trained Skill. Whenever you roll a Skill Check with that Skill, a result of 2-7 on the die is always treated as though you had rolled an 8. You can select this Talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different Skill to gain the benefits of this Talent.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
